title: 17 Mile Drive eBike Tour in Monterey
blurb:
Explore the stunning 17-Mile Drive on an electric bike, where the beauty of the Monterey Peninsula unfolds around you. This self-guided GPS eBike tour allows you to effortlessly navigate through picturesque coastal views, dramatic cliffs, and luxurious neighborhoods. As you ride, a GPS guide offers insights into local history and highlights iconic spots like Lovers Point and the Lone Cypress. Perfect for those seeking a unique outdoor experience, this tour provides the freedom to explore at your own pace while soaking in the fresh ocean air and breathtaking scenery. 

- Duration: Option of choosing between 2 hours or 4 hours
- Ideal for individuals and groups without a driver’s license requirement
- GPS audio guide included for enriching exploration
- Visit renowned landmarks such as Spanish Bay and Pebble Beach
